device_menu.title: Add zones
device_menu.description: Configured zones: {zone_count}. Each zone creates a stateless trigger button and, when feedback fields are filled in, a separate status entity.

add_device.title: Add zone
add_device.description: Create one BeWave zone. The trigger command becomes a button entity. The feedback messages create a separate read-only status entity.

tcp.title: Connect BeWave hub
tcp.description: Configure the IP address or hostname of the BeWave hub.

mqtt.title: BE WAVE via MQTT
mqtt.description: Switches and functional detectors are discovered automatically, without diagnostic entities. Status base topic matches BE WAVE Publish topic; command base topic matches Subscribe topic. Example: bewave and bewave/command.

init.title: Manage zones
init.description: Configured zones: {zone_count}. Add, edit, or remove zones.

add_device.title: Add zone
add_device.description: Create one BeWave zone. The trigger command becomes a button entity. The feedback messages create a separate read-only status entity.

edit_device.title: Edit zone
edit_device.description: Edit the zone details. The trigger command is sent when the button is pressed. Feedback messages update the separate status entity.

mqtt.title: BE WAVE MQTT
mqtt.description: Change the name and command base topic. Switches have no inactivity expiry. The command base topic must match BE WAVE Subscribe topic. To change broker IP, open [the MQTT integration](/config/integrations/integration/mqtt) and select Reconfigure.

data.name: Name
data.command_prefix: Command base topic (BE WAVE Subscribe topic)

connection.title: Change hub IP address
connection.description: Existing devices and entity identities are preserved.

mqtt_menu.title: Manage BE WAVE
mqtt_menu.description: Change settings, search for new devices or remove an old record.

search.title: Search for new devices
search.description: Request a BE WAVE synchronization. New devices appear when their MQTT status arrives. Removed devices remain excluded.

remove_mqtt_device.title: Remove a device
remove_mqtt_device.description: Choose the device to remove from this Home Assistant connection. It will not reappear automatically. The device stays in BE WAVE. Type and ID help distinguish duplicate names.

restore_mqtt_device.title: Restore a removed device
restore_mqtt_device.description: Choose a previously removed device to allow again. It appears after a new status message from the hub.

storage.title: Manage BE WAVE storage

language.title: Taal / Language
language.description: Choose Dutch or English for function names, the search button and menu choices. Custom device names and entity IDs are preserved. Form titles and state labels such as “Detected” follow your Home Assistant profile language. The connection is not restarted.
